decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility 4547 (DSM2) point with the US Census Bureau geocoder's point for 1401 Northridge Circle, Altoona, IA 50009, the address Lightedge publishes for Des Moines Data Center #2.
conversion: Geocoder output in NAD83 geographic coordinates used as WGS84 without transformation (sub-metre difference); rounded to 7 decimals.

dsm1_census_point.note: Same TIGER edge and range; context only.
